top_signals.summary:
In 2021, Sungmin Cho wrote, “South Korea’s Taiwan Conundrum,” where he argued Seoul’s complex strategic position makes engagement on questions of involvement over a Taiwan contingency complicated. Five years later, we asked him to revisit his arguments.Image: U.S. Navy (Photo by Seaman Apprentice Cale Hatch)In your 2021 article, you argued that Seoul should more actively engage in strategic dialogue with Washington on Taiwan issues. top_signals.title: Ellawn: Brookfield Sees Many Mideast Opportunities
top_signals.summary: Brookfield closed its $2 billion Mideast fund in August and Jad Ellawn, their Managing Partner and Regional Head of Middle East says they're seeing multiple opportunities in the Middle East. He spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on Horizons Middle East & Africa and explained why they think there is a growth in the regional population based on the data received from their investments in the likes of payment platforms and school enrollments (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.summary: Microsoft today released updates to remedy at least 398 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and supported software, including one weakness that is already being actively exploited and two others that were publicly detailed prior to today.

top_signals.title: SGX's Kan: Investors Are Abandoning Siloed Trading
top_signals.summary: SGX Group Head of Derivatives Janice Kan believes investors are abandoning siloed trading, and are now demanding a single venue where they can trade global equities, sectors and currencies together. She speaks with Haslinda Amin on "Insight with Haslinda Amin." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Ebola is hollowing out basic healthcare as Congo’s outbreak surpasses 8,000 cases
top_signals.summary: Use of seven essential health services has fallen 42% in four major Ebola hotspots in Ituri province, the outbreak's epicenter, according to ACAPS.
